steps: Create a LinkedIn developer app tied to a Company Page (organization posting also needs an admin role on that Page)

On the Products tab request the products that grant the scopes you need (Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect for openid, profile and email; Share on LinkedIn for w_member_social); the scopes available to the app are listed on its Auth tab
On the Auth tab add the redirect URL below
Store the client id and secret: switchboard vault set linkedin_client_id and switchboard vault set linkedin_client_secret
Register them: switchboard authconfig add linkedin --client-id-ref linkedin_client_id --client-secret-ref linkedin_client_secret
Connect: switchboard connect linkedin --account personal --scopes openid,profile,email,w_member_social
notes: Observed 2026-10-23 (LinkedIn 3-legged OAuth doc): authorize at https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/authorization, exchange at POST https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken with client_id and client_secret as form fields, scopes are space delimited, access tokens live 60 days, the authorization code lives 30 minutes, and requesting a different scope invalidates earlier access tokens.

Observed (same doc): programmatic refresh tokens are available only to a limited set of partners; without one an expired token means the person goes through consent again. The engine marks the account EXPIRED and prints the reconnect command.

Observed (same doc): the doc tells you to add the redirect URL via HTTPS and does not mention PKCE. UNVERIFIED whether LinkedIn accepts an http loopback redirect URL; if the console refuses it, use an https tunnel via switchboard authconfig add ... --redirect-uri.

ADR section 8 (Observed there): w_member_social and r_organization_admin cannot be combined, r_member_social is restricted to approved users. Official API only; no browser automation (a LinkedIn restriction happened before).
The posts API needs a Linkedin-Version: YYYYMM header on every call; the recipes in ADR phase P4 set it per call, so it is not fixed here. Marketing version 202511 sunsets 2026-11-16 (ADR section 7).
UNVERIFIED: the identity probe URL (the OpenID Connect userinfo endpoint) was not fetched when this file was written.
